requirements.heading: DMARC Failure Reports
requirements.text: When multiple Uniform Resource Identifiers (URIs) are provided to receive failure reports, the report generator MUST make an attempt to deliver to each of them.

requirements.heading: DMARC Failure Reports
requirements.text: External destinations MUST be verified (see Section 5).

requirements.heading: DMARC Failure Reports
requirements.text: Report generators MUST NOT consider "ruf" tags in DMARC Policy Records that have a "psd=y" tag, unless there are specific agreements between the interested parties.

requirements.heading: DMARC Failure Reports
requirements.text: Report generators MUST implement a rate-limit on outgoing reports so as not to flood Report Consumers with excessive reports, which would allow denial of service (see Section 8.1).

requirements.heading: Other Failure Reports
requirements.text: A Mail Receiver that generates DMARC failure reports MAY choose to issue failure reports of the type specific to the authentication mechanism that failed instead of, or in addition to, the DMARC failure report type described here.

requirements.heading: Other Failure Reports
requirements.text: The Receiver SHALL determine which failure report types, if any, to transmit based on its own policy, the failure in question, and the content of the "fo" tag in the retrieved DMARC Policy Record.

requirements.heading: Reporting Format Update
requirements.text: * DKIM-Domain, DKIM-Identity, DKIM-Selector (REQUIRED for DKIM failures of an aligned identifier)

requirements.heading: Reporting Format Update
requirements.text: * DKIM-Canonicalized-Header, DKIM-Canonicalized-Body (OPTIONAL if reporting a DKIM failure)

requirements.heading: Reporting Format Update
requirements.text: * SPF-DNS (REQUIRED for SPF failure of an aligned identifier)

requirements.heading: Reporting Format Update
requirements.text: Note that a failure report generator MAY also independently produce an ARF message for any or all of the underlying authentication methods.

requirements.heading: Verifying External Destinations
requirements.text: In case of external destinations, a Mail Receiver who generates failure reports MUST use the Verifying External Destinations procedure described in Section 4 of [RFC9990], substituting the "ruf" tag where the "rua" tag appears in that procedure.

requirements.heading: Transport
requirements.text: Email streams carrying DMARC failure reports SHOULD be DMARC-aligned.
